name: autopilot
description: Give it a goal and success criteria; it plans, delegates, verifies and retries until the criteria pass or it needs you.

budgetUsd.title: Default budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: The budget a new run's setup card starts with; the run stops once its turns and subagents cost this much.

maxMinutes.title: Default time limit (minutes)
maxMinutes.description: The time limit a new run's setup card starts with (paused and blocked time do not count).

maxFailures.title: Failures in a row
maxFailures.description: A run stops after this many failed check rounds (or failed turns) in a row (1-10). The second failed round is retried with harder thinking and a stronger model.

maxTurns.title: Turns per run
maxTurns.description: The most prompts one run sends (2-100), whatever else happens.

checkTimeoutSeconds.title: Check timeout (seconds)
checkTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one criterion's command may run before it counts as failed (5-600).

allowWorkflow.title: Allow workflow by default
allowWorkflow.description: Tick "allow workflow" on new setup cards: Claude may then use the Workflow tool for a big step.
